name: EPIC 245988600
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 12, 10.7 solar radii and 0.92 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 245988600 (K2 campaign 12): PARAM radius (solar radii) 10.672843 (16th-84th percentiles 10.296282-11.158933), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 245988600 (K2 campaign 12): PARAM mass (solar masses) 0.91664 (16th-84th percentiles 0.842908-1.018519), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 245988600: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4569.2173 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 245988600 (K2 campaign 12): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3769.023438 (16th-84th percentiles 3647.304688-3904.765625), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.07 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 3,769 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 0.92 solar masses and 10.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,569 K at its surface.
